column1: # key_sabran_1631.tsv -- George Lasry's reconstruction of the cipher used in BnF fr.4134 (Sabran's own outgoing/
# incoming correspondence) and confirmed by him also in BnF Baluze 155 f.79 (Louis XIII to Sabran, 28 Mar 1631).
# Source: sources/cryptiana/web/GL.htm, section "Melchior de Sabran (1631)" (S. Tomokiyo's page, crediting
# George Lasry, dated by Lasry 25/05/2022 on the key image); image fetched 24 Sept 2026 from
# cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/GL/BnF_fr4134.jpg (624x261px, the only resolution published -- several cells are
# genuinely hard to read at this size and some are marked "?" by Lasry himself, kept below).
# This is the "Sabran (1631)" key named in this worker's brief, NOT the separate Farnese-to-Sabran key at
# Baluze 156 f.40 (GL.htm's next section, "?Odoardo Farnese, Duke of Parma (1637)", a different cipher).
# grade H (read directly from Lasry's published key image); kind: letter (symbol alphabet) | nomenclator (2-digit
# code for a word/syllable). Symbol shapes are given as short descriptions (sign column), since the glyphs are
# hand-drawn secretary-hand marks with no ASCII equivalent -- matching convention to fr20140-danzay-1557/key.tsv.
